title: Publish the native END artifact verdict atomically and preserve it when the turn is no longer current
outcome: A native observation cannot persist or publish an exit-derived Passed before its actual declared artifact verdict, and an exactly matched original END retains that display verdict even when the originating turn no longer admits credit. Keep credit fail-closed and generic launcher rules unchanged.
acceptance: Publish the native END artifact verdict atomically and preserve it when the turn is no longer current is done
